name: dsh-session-rules
description: Workspace- and session-scoped rules for DeepSeek Harness · 按工作区/会话分层维护守则，会话里逐层勾选带入，默认关闭

meta.title: 会话守则 · Session Rules
meta.description:
按工作区层级维护守则；会话里逐层勾选要带入的内容，默认关闭，勾选后才进入系统提示词。写入文件：$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-session-rules/rules.json。

Workspace- and session-scoped rules for DeepSeek Harness. Each workspace keeps one rules block and child workspaces can only tick which ancestors they inherit. A session ticks any subset plus its own block; nothing is injected until ticked. Data lives in $DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-session-rules/rules.json.

注意：勾选后这些文字每轮都会随系统提示词发送，会有额外 token 消耗，勾得越多消耗越大。
Note: ticked rules are sent with every request, so they add token cost every turn.
